name: 94014 · Daly City, CA
findings: ZIP 94014 (Daly City) has 78 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94014 (Daly City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
